description:
Find the best paid x402 API for a task. Ranked by paying wallets and repeat buyers (not raw call counts, which are easy to inflate), one endpoint per seller, with price and a caution where a seller's numbers look unusual. Tollkit runs this ranking and sells tools too; its own are ranked the same way and marked sold_by_tollkit.

$0.01 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

task.description: What the tool should do, e.g. "web search" or "token price on solana".

name: best_x402_tools
title: Best x402 tools for a task
